tool_schemas.name: extract_resume
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a resume in the given workspace by storing raw content (pasted text or an uploaded file reference) and starting an extraction job that produces extracted text/metadata; it returns the resume identifier and the created extraction job for tracking. If you supply resume_id we attach/replace the raw content on that resume; if omitted we create a new resume owned by workspace_id (title is stored when provided), and repeated requests with the same idempotency_key return the original result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if source_type is missing/invalid or required source fields are inconsistent (e.g., paste without raw_text, upload without raw_file_url/raw_file_mime, bad raw_file_sha256), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace, NOT_FOUND if workspace_id (or resume_id when provided) doesn’t exist in the workspace, CONFLICT if resume_id belongs to a different workspace or the resume is in a state that cannot accept new raw content, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when workspace/job limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that will own the created/updated resume and job.

resume_id.description: Existing resume to attach extracted raw content to; if omitted a new resume may be created.

title.description: Optional human-friendly title for the resume.

source_type.description: Source of the raw resume content being extracted.

raw_text.description: Raw resume text to store/extract from (used when source_type is paste).

raw_file_url.description: URL to the uploaded resume file to extract text from.

raw_file_mime.description: MIME type of the uploaded resume file (e.g., application/pdf).

raw_file_sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the uploaded resume file.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate repeated extract requests.

tool_schemas.name: parse_resume
tool_schemas.description: Starts a parsing job that converts the resume’s latest extracted/raw content into a structured representation for the requested schema_version and returns the parse job details (and the target resume reference). Parsing is asynchronous; use the returned job to track completion, and repeated requests with the same idempotency_key return the original job. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported schema_version or malformed identifiers, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace/resume, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume doesn’t exist, CONFLICT if the resume has no extractable content available to parse or already has an incompatible in-flight processing job, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when job creation limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that owns the resume and processing job.

resume_id.description: Resume to parse into a structured representation.

schema_version.description: Target parsed schema version to produce.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate repeated parse requests.

tool_schemas.name: generate_resume
tool_schemas.description: Starts a modernization/generation job for the specified resume and returns a job that will produce a generated resume artifact in the requested format (text/markdown/html/docx/pdf/json). The output is created from the resume’s latest available structured/parsed data when present, otherwise from extracted text where supported, and idempotency_key deduplicates repeated generate requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported format or malformed identifiers, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace/resume, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume doesn’t exist, CONFLICT if there is no usable extracted/parsed content to generate from or generation is not allowed for the resume’s current state, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when generation limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that owns the resume and processing job.

resume_id.description: Resume to generate a modernized output for.

format.description: Desired output format of the generated resume.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate repeated generate requests.

tool_schemas.name: summarize_experience
tool_schemas.description: Creates a summarization job that analyzes the resume and produces an experience summary (e.g., role highlights and concise narrative) and returns the job for tracking. The summary is generated from the resume’s available extracted/parsed content, and idempotency_key deduplicates repeated requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed identifiers, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace/resume, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume doesn’t exist, CONFLICT if the resume has no usable content to summarize or an incompatible in-flight job prevents starting, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when summarization limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that owns the resume and processing job.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate repeated summarize requests.

tool_schemas.name: skill_gap_analyzer
tool_schemas.description: Starts a skill gap analysis job that compares the resume against the provided job_description and returns a job that will produce missing skills, matched skills, and recommended additions. idempotency_key deduplicates repeated analysis requests for the same workspace/resume. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if job_description is missing/empty or identifiers are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace/resume, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume doesn’t exist, CONFLICT if the resume has no usable extracted/parsed content to compare or an incompatible in-flight job blocks processing, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when analysis limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that owns the resume and processing job.

resume_id.description: Resume to analyze for skill gaps.

job_description.description: Target job description text to compare against the resume.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate repeated skill gap requests.

tool_schemas.name: resume_score
tool_schemas.description: Creates a scoring job that evaluates the resume quality and optionally scores fit against the provided job_description, returning the job that will produce the score breakdown and signals used. If job_description is omitted, we score general resume quality/ATS readiness using available resume content; idempotency_key deduplicates repeated score requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed identifiers (or invalid job_description when provided), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace/resume, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume doesn’t exist, CONFLICT if the resume has no usable content to score or an incompatible in-flight job blocks processing, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when scoring limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that owns the resume and processing job.

job_description.description: Optional job description text to score fit against.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate repeated score requests.

tool_schemas.name: format_converter
tool_schemas.description: Starts a conversion job that takes the resume’s latest generated output artifact and converts it to to_format, returning the conversion job and target artifact reference when available. This endpoint does not generate new content; it only converts an existing generated output, and idempotency_key deduplicates repeated conversion requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported to_format or malformed identifiers, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace/resume, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume doesn’t exist, CONFLICT if the resume has no generated output to convert or the requested conversion is not supported for the current artifact/state, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when conversion limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that owns the resume and processing job.

resume_id.description: Resume whose latest generated output should be converted.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate repeated conversion requests.

tool_schemas.name: anonymize_resume
tool_schemas.description: Creates an anonymization job that redacts or replaces personally identifying information from the resume’s content and returns the job that will produce an anonymized artifact. The anonymized output is derived from the resume’s available extracted/parsed/generated content where applicable, and idempotency_key deduplicates repeated anonymization requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed identifiers, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace/resume, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume doesn’t exist, CONFLICT if there is no usable content to anonymize or anonymization is not allowed for the resume’s current state/in-flight jobs, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when anonymization limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that owns the resume and processing job.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate repeated anonymize requests.

tool_schemas.name: grammar_check
tool_schemas.description: Starts a grammar/spell/style check job for the resume and returns a job that will produce issue annotations and/or patched text according to return_format. Optional language/style/severity tune the checker, and include_suggestions controls whether each issue includes proposed fixes; idempotency_key deduplicates repeated checks. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported enums (style/severity/return_format), malformed identifiers, or invalid language values, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace/resume, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume doesn’t exist, CONFLICT if the resume has no usable text to check or an incompatible in-flight job blocks processing, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when checking limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID that owns the resume and job.

resume_id.description: Resume ID to run grammar/spell/style checks against.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to deduplicate the processing job.

language.description: Language hint for grammar checking (e.g., en, en-US).

style.description: Preferred writing style to enforce during checks.

severity.description: How strict the checker should be.

return_format.description: Whether to return issues only, patched text, or both.

include_suggestions.description: Whether to include suggested fixes for each issue.

tool_schemas.name: import_linkedin
tool_schemas.description: Creates a LinkedIn profile import job for the workspace using the selected method and returns the job for tracking along with the resolved profile reference when available. You may provide either profile_url or public_identifier to identify the profile to import; idempotency_key deduplicates repeated import requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided, both are invalid, or method is unsupported, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you can’t access the workspace, NOT_FOUND if workspace_id doesn’t exist, CONFLICT if an import for the same profile is already in progress or the workspace disallows starting a new import due to state/limits, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when import limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID that will own the LinkedIn profile import job.

public_identifier.description: LinkedIn public identifier (vanity slug) to import as an alternative to profile_url.

method.description: Import method to use when creating the LinkedIn profile import job.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to deduplicate the processing job.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def import_linkedin(workspace_id, profile_url=None, public_identifier=None, method=None, idempotency_key=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid, urllib.parse
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0244000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0244000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    _t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"

    def _ensure_list(x): return x if isinstance(x, list) else []

    def _log(status, error_code=None, workspace_id_used=None, job_id=None):
        logs = _ensure_list(_load("request_logs.json"))
        logs.append({
            "id": "rmz_req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()[:19],
            "timestamp": now,
            "endpoint": "import_linkedin",
            "workspace_id": workspace_id_used,
            "job_id": job_id,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - _t0) * 1000),
            "error_code": error_code
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    def _month_key(dt): return dt.strftime("%Y-%m")

    def _job_month(job):
        ts = job.get("created_at") or job.get("timestamp") or job.get("started_at") or job.get("updated_at")
        if not isinstance(ts, str) or not ts:
            return _month_key(now_dt)
        try:
            d = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except Exception:
            return _month_key(now_dt)
        return d.strftime("%Y-%m")

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        return prefix + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()[:19]

    # ---- validate (relaxed URL validation per audit: accept non-linkedin strings; only require string)
    if not isinstance(workspace_id, str) or not re.match(r"^rmz_wsp_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", workspace_id):
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid workspace_id.")
    if method is None or not isinstance(method, str) or method not in ("api", "scrape", "manual"):
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unsupported method.")
    if profile_url is not None and not isinstance(profile_url, str):
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "profile_url must be a string.")
    if public_identifier is not None and not isinstance(public_identifier, str):
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "public_identifier must be a string.")
    if idempotency_key is not None and not isinstance(idempotency_key, str):
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "idempotency_key must be a string when provided.")

    if (profile_url is None or not profile_url.strip()) and (public_identifier is None or not public_identifier.strip()):
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Either profile_url or public_identifier is required.")

    norm_url = profile_url.strip() if isinstance(profile_url, str) and profile_url.strip() else None
    norm_public = public_identifier.strip() if isinstance(public_identifier, str) and public_identifier.strip() else None
    # best-effort normalize a linkedin URL if it is one; but do not reject other URLs
    if norm_url:
        try:
            u = urllib.parse.urlparse(norm_url)
            if u.scheme in ("http", "https") and u.netloc:
                norm_url = urllib.parse.urlunparse((u.scheme, u.netloc, u.path.rstrip("/"), "", "", ""))
        except Exception:
            pass

    # ---- workspace + quotas
    workspaces = _ensure_list(_load("workspaces.json"))
    ws = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspace_id), None)
    if not ws:
        _log("error", "NOT_FOUND", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found.")
    if ws.get("status") != "active":
        _log("error", "QUOTA_EXCEEDED", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Workspace is not active; job creation is not allowed.", workspace_status=ws.get("status"))

    jobs = _ensure_list(_load("processing_jobs.json"))
    if idempotency_key is not None and idempotency_key.strip():
        existing = next((j for j in jobs if j.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and j.get("tool_name") == "import_linkedin" and j.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key), None)
        if existing:
            linkedin_profiles = _ensure_list(_load("linkedin_profiles.json"))
            lp = None
            lpid = existing.get("linkedin_profile_id")
            if lpid:
                lp = next((p for p in linkedin_profiles if p.get("id") == lpid), None)
            _log("ok", None, workspace_id_used=workspace_id, job_id=existing.get("id"))
            return {"job": existing, "linkedin_profile": lp}

    mk = _month_key(now_dt)
    month_jobs = [j for j in jobs if j.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and _job_month(j) == mk]
    used_jobs = len(month_jobs)
    used_tokens = 0
    for j in month_jobs:
        pt = j.get("prompt_tokens")
        ct = j.get("completion_tokens")
        if isinstance(pt, int) and pt >= 0: used_tokens += pt
        if isinstance(ct, int) and ct >= 0: used_tokens += ct

    monthly_job_limit = ws.get("monthly_job_limit")
    monthly_token_limit = ws.get("monthly_token_limit")
    if not isinstance(monthly_job_limit, int) or monthly_job_limit < 0: monthly_job_limit = 0
    if not isinstance(monthly_token_limit, int) or monthly_token_limit < 0: monthly_token_limit = 0

    projected_tokens = 1800
    if used_jobs + 1 > monthly_job_limit:
        _log("error", "QUOTA_EXCEEDED", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Monthly job limit exceeded.", monthly_job_limit=monthly_job_limit, used_jobs=used_jobs)
    if used_tokens + projected_tokens > monthly_token_limit:
        _log("error", "QUOTA_EXCEEDED", workspace_id_used=workspace_id)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Monthly token limit would be exceeded by this request.", monthly_token_limit=monthly_token_limit, used_tokens=used_tokens, projected_tokens=projected_tokens)

    # ---- create/update linkedin profile record
    linkedin_profiles = _ensure_list(_load("linkedin_profiles.json"))
    # unique(workspace_id, profile_url) where profile_url is not null
    lp = None
    if norm_url:
        lp = next((p for p in linkedin_profiles if p.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and p.get("profile_url") == norm_url and p.get("status") != "deleted"), None)
    if lp is None and norm_public:
        lp = next((p for p in linkedin_profiles if p.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and p.get("public_identifier") == norm_public and p.get("status") != "deleted"), None)

    created_new = False
    if lp is None:
        created_new = True
        lp = {
            "id": _gen_id("rmz_lnk_"),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "status": "pending",
            "method": method,
            "profile_url": norm_url,
            "public_identifier": norm_public,
            "raw_profile_json": None,
            "normalized_resume_json": None,
            "error_code": None,
            "error_message": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        linkedin_profiles.append(lp)
    else:
        # refresh identifiers/method if provided
        lp["method"] = method
        if norm_url:
            lp["profile_url"] = norm_url
        if norm_public:
            lp["public_identifier"] = norm_public
        if lp.get("status") == "failed":
            lp["status"] = "pending"
            lp["error_code"] = None
            lp["error_message"] = None
        lp["updated_at"] = now

    _save("linkedin_profiles.json", linkedin_profiles)

    # ---- create job row
    job = {
        "id": _gen_id("rmz_job_"),
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "resume_id": None,
        "linkedin_profile_id": lp.get("id"),
        "tool_name": "import_linkedin",
        "status": "queued",
        "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
        "input_json": {"profile_url": norm_url, "public_identifier": norm_public, "method": method},
        "output_json": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "cost_usd": 0.02,
        "prompt_tokens": int(projected_tokens * 0.6),
        "completion_tokens": int(projected_tokens * 0.4),
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    }
    jobs.append(job)
    _save("processing_jobs.json", jobs)

    # simulate processing: if profile already has normalized_resume_json, succeed quickly; else keep pending but still succeed with stub mapping
    job["status"] = "running"
    job["started_at"] = now
    job["updated_at"] = now
    _save("processing_jobs.json", jobs)

    # produce normalized resume json (minimal) when possible
    normalized = lp.get("normalized_resume_json")
    if normalized is None:
        normalized = {
            "schema_version": "v1",
            "source": "linkedin",
            "profile": {"url": lp.get("profile_url"), "public_identifier": lp.get("public_identifier")},
            "experience": [],
            "education": [],
            "skills": []
        }
        lp["normalized_resume_json"] = normalized
        lp["status"] = "ready"
        lp["updated_at"] = now
        _save("linkedin_profiles.json", linkedin_profiles)

    # create/refresh resume row source_type='linkedin' derived from normalized
    resumes = _ensure_list(_load("resumes.json"))
    linked_resume = next((r for r in resumes if r.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and r.get("source_type") == "linkedin" and r.get("raw_file_sha256") is None and r.get("title") == (lp.get("public_identifier") or lp.get("profile_url")) and r.get("status") != "deleted"), None)
    if linked_resume is None:
        linked_resume = {
            "id": _gen_id("rmz_rsm_"),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "status": "ready",
            "source_type": "linkedin",
            "title": lp.get("public_identifier") or lp.get("profile_url") or "LinkedIn Import",
            "raw_text": None,
            "raw_file_url": None,
            "raw_file_mime": None,
            "raw_file_sha256": None,
            "parsed_resume_json": normalized,
            "parsed_schema_version": "v1",
            "anonymized_resume_json": None,
            "latest_generated_resume_text": None,
            "latest_generated_format": None,
            "latest_cover_letter_text": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        resumes.append(linked_resume)
    else:
        # refresh parsed representation from normalized
        linked_resume["parsed_resume_json"] = normalized
        linked_resume["parsed_schema_version"] = "v1"
        if linked_resume.get("status") in ("draft", "processing"):
            linked_resume["status"] = "ready"
        linked_resume["updated_at"] = now
    _save("resumes.json", resumes)

    job["status"] = "succeeded"
    job["finished_at"] = now
    job["updated_at"] = now
    job["output_json"] = {"linkedin_profile_id": lp.get("id"), "resume_id": linked_resume.get("id")}
    _save("processing_jobs.json", jobs)

    _log("ok", None, workspace_id_used=workspace_id, job_id=job.get("id"))
    return {"job": job, "linkedin_profile": lp, "resume": linked_resume, "created_profile": created_new}

tool_schemas.name: extract_linkedin_profile_api
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses via idempotency_key) a LinkedIn profile extraction job in the given workspace using the API method and populates the target LinkedIn profile record identified by linkedin_profile_id, or creates/targets a record from profile_url/public_identifier; returns the extraction job details and the LinkedIn profile reference. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither linkedin_profile_id nor a profile_url/public_identifier is provided, or if identifiers don’t match required formats; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or specified linkedin_profile_id does not exist in the workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace, CONFLICT if the target profile is in a non-extractable state (e.g., already processing), and RATE_LIMITED if workspace or account extraction quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID that owns the LinkedIn extraction job.

linkedin_profile_id.description: LinkedIn profile record ID to populate via API extraction.

profile_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL to extract (used if linkedin_profile_id is not provided).

public_identifier.description: LinkedIn public identifier (vanity slug) to extract (used if profile_url is not provided).

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to deduplicate the processing job.

tool_schemas.name: extract_linkedin_profile
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses via idempotency_key) a LinkedIn profile extraction job in the given workspace using the requested method (scrape or manual) and populates the target LinkedIn profile record identified by linkedin_profile_id, or creates/targets a record from profile_url/public_identifier; returns the extraction job details and the LinkedIn profile reference. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if method is missing/invalid, or if neither linkedin_profile_id nor a profile_url/public_identifier is provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or specified linkedin_profile_id does not exist in the workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace, CONFLICT if the target profile is not eligible for extraction (e.g., already processing), and RATE_LIMITED if extraction quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID that owns the LinkedIn extraction job.

linkedin_profile_id.description: LinkedIn profile record ID to populate via extraction.

profile_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL to extract (used if linkedin_profile_id is not provided).

public_identifier.description: LinkedIn public identifier (vanity slug) to extract (used if profile_url is not provided).

method.description: Extraction method to use for non-API extraction.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to deduplicate the processing job.

tool_schemas.name: update_resume_for_job
tool_schemas.description: Starts (or reuses via idempotency_key) a job-specific tailoring run for the given resume in the workspace using the provided job context (job_title/job_description and optional company/location/seniority), and returns a tailoring job record plus a reference to the generated tailored output in the requested output_format (and an optional change log). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required IDs are malformed, output_format/seniority are not supported, or if job_title/job_description are missing when required for tailoring; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume_id does not exist or does not belong to the workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace, CONFLICT if the resume is in a state that cannot be tailored (e.g., locked by another active job), and RATE_LIMITED if processing limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID that owns the resume and tailoring job.

resume_id.description: Resume ID to tailor for a specific job.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to deduplicate the processing job.

job_title.description: Target job title to tailor the resume toward.

job_description.description: Full job description text to tailor the resume against.

company_name.description: Target company name for tailoring context.

seniority.description: Target seniority level to tune tone and scope.

output_format.description: Desired output format for the tailored resume.

include_change_log.description: Whether to include a structured summary of edits made.

tool_schemas.name: generate_cover_letter
tool_schemas.description: Starts (or reuses via idempotency_key) a cover-letter generation job for the given resume in the workspace using the provided job and company context, and returns the job record plus the generated cover letter in output_format (and structured fields when output_format is json). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tone/length/output_format are invalid or if required IDs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume_id does not exist or is not owned by the workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace, CONFLICT if the resume is not eligible for generation due to an active conflicting job, and RATE_LIMITED if generation quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID that owns the resume and cover letter job.

resume_id.description: Resume ID to base the cover letter on.

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if suggested_keywords_limit is out of range, booleans are invalid, or required IDs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or resume_id does not exist in the workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace, CONFLICT if the resume is currently being processed by an incompatible job, and RATE_LIMITED if optimization quotas are exceeded.

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range or cursor is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated (and FORBIDDEN if the account is not permitted to list tools).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def list_tools(limit=None, cursor=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0244000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0244000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    _t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _ensure_list(x): return x if isinstance(x, list) else []

    def _log(status_code, error_code=None):
        logs = _ensure_list(_load("request_logs.json"))
        logs.append({
            "id": "rmz_req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()[:19],
            "timestamp": now,
            "endpoint": "list_tools",
            "workspace_id": None,
            "status": status_code,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - _t0) * 1000),
            "error_code": error_code
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    if limit is None:
        limit = 50
    if not isinstance(limit, int) or limit < 1 or limit > 200:
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "limit must be between 1 and 200.")

    off = 0
    if cursor is None or cursor == "":
        off = 0
    elif isinstance(cursor, str) and re.match(r"^rmz_wsp_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", cursor):
        off = 0
    elif isinstance(cursor, str):
        try:
            off = int(cursor)
        except ValueError:
            _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid cursor.")
        if off < 0:
            _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid cursor.")
    else:
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid cursor.")

    tools = [
        {"name": "extract_resume"},
        {"name": "parse_resume"},
        {"name": "generate_resume"},
        {"name": "summarize_experience"},
        {"name": "skill_gap_analyzer"},
        {"name": "resume_score"},
        {"name": "format_converter"},
        {"name": "anonymize_resume"},
        {"name": "grammar_check"},
        {"name": "import_linkedin"},
        {"name": "extract_linkedin_profile_api"},
        {"name": "extract_linkedin_profile"},
        {"name": "update_resume_for_job"},
        {"name": "generate_cover_letter"},
        {"name": "keyword_optimizer"},
        {"name": "ats_friendliness_check"},
        {"name": "update_parsed_resume"},
        {"name": "apply_ats_suggestions"},
        {"name": "subscribe_to_resource"},
        {"name": "unsubscribe_from_resource"},
        {"name": "list_resource_subscriptions"},
        {"name": "trigger_test_notifications"},
    ]

    total = len(tools)
    page = tools[off: off + limit]
    next_off = off + len(page)
    has_more = next_off < total
    next_cursor = str(next_off) if has_more else None

    _log("ok", None)
    return {
        "object": "list",
        "data": page,
        "limit": limit,
        "cursor": cursor,
        "next_cursor": next_cursor,
        "has_more": has_more,
        "total": total
    }
